title: Exit Status
story: Every command leaves a number behind: 0 for success, anything else for failure. $? holds the last one.
goal: Write a function is_even that returns success for even numbers. For each argument print N is even or N is odd.
starter: # return 0 means true, return 1 means false

tests.label: mixed
tests.expect:
1 is odd
2 is even
7 is odd
10 is even

hints: A function's exit status is the status of its last command.
(( $1 % 2 == 0 )) succeeds when the test is true.
socratic: What does if do with a function?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Exit Status”?
alt:
is_even() { [ $(( $1 % 2 )) -eq 0 ]; }
for n in "$@"; do
  is_even "$n" && echo "$n is even" || echo "$n is odd"
done
